[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Panjiang Peninsula | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=235 }} The [[Panjiang Peninsula]] lies on the southwestern edge of [[Shing Jea Island]], with [[Cantha]]ns populating mainly the peaceful farming community of [[Kaitan Village]] in the East and a small port, [[Port Kaimu]], on the southwestern end. The port has mostly been taken over by the hostile [[Crimson Skull]] guild. [[Naga]] populate the southeastern cave system known as the [[Raiyan Cave]] as well as the western waterfront. The relatively more inland areas have wandering groups of [[Kappa]]. == Getting there == This area lies to the southwest of [[Tsumei Village]]. Several early [[profession]]-related quests will lead players here. == Shrines == ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: * [[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] ** At the exit into Tsumei Once she is well clear of the village, past the last [[Kaitan Village]] sign, she will turn hostile. == Notes == * These [[:category:Shing Jea Island quests|Shing Jea Island quests]] will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: ** [[Cash Crops]] ** [[Quimang's Last Stand]] ** [[Reaping the Naga]] ** [[Shackled Spirits]] ** [[Sparring Elements]] ** [[The Box of Illusions]] ** [[The Crop Thieves]] ** [[The Siege at Tsumei Village]] ** [[The Threat Grows]] * These [[festival quest]]s will also affect the spawns in this area: ** [[Darkness at Kaitan]] ** [[Hopeless Romantic]] ** [[Just My Luck]] ** [[The Big Bang]] * Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 3.3% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title track. * [[Kappa]] and [[Crimson Skull]] are hostile to each other, though their patrols only overlap in a small area. *{{Vanquisher|count = 183|low = 131|high = 235}} ** Skills like [[Shelter]], [[Union]], [[Shield of Absorption]], and [[Protective Spirit]] are highly recommended as this area is populated by numerous [[Elementalist]]s and damage-dealing [[Ritualist]]s. *** The vast majority of damage dealt by foes in this area comes from [[Ranged attacks|projectile attacks]] and/or [[Projectile spell|projectile spells]]. Conveniently, the area's naturally hilly/mountainous terrain makes it very easy to break [[Line of sight|line of sight]]. *** [[Mantra of Frost]] and [[Mantra of Lightning]] are also very effective in this area due to the prevalence of [[cold damage|cold]] and [[lightning damage]]. ** Without active quests the area east of the [[Tsumei Village]] entrance doesn't have any enemies. ** A hidden [[Naga]] group in [[Raiyan Cave]] will spawn if one ventures close to the waterline at the southern edge of the cave. ** A hidden pair of [[Kappa]] will appear if one ventures along the beach immediately north of [[Pei the Skull Blade]]'s ship. There's another hidden Kappa group south of [[Kaitan Village]], on the sandy beach. ** Naga groups will also appear if one traverses the water along the western edge. ** Starting from the [[resurrection shrine]] along the southern edge west of Raiyan Cave, and at several points along the path towards and around Port Kaimu, are many hidden groups of Crimson Skull. At least one of the hidden groups at Port Kaimu may be required to be killed in order for the vanquish to complete. ** There are two hidden [[Lesser Oni]] in this area: *** On the southwestern sandy beach. *** Along the curving mountain path west of Losai Hapatu, the [[Kappa Shell]] [[collector]]. **** The Lesser Oni that spawns west of Losai Hapatu has to be killed to complete the vanquish even when it is still hidden. ** Vanquishing during [[Darkness at Kaitan]] (during the [[Dragon Festival]]) produces some spawn changes. *** Naga groups spawn in the village, in groups of five. *** Raiyan Cave is filled with groups of 1-2 [[Lesser Grasp]]s. *** The "s"-shaped area east of the bridge on the southern edge of the map is empty - this eliminates several closely packed groups of Crimson Skull. *** Overall, the result is a slight reduction in the total number of foes. ** Vanquishing during [[Togo's Ultimatum]] will affect the spawns in this area. *** The Crimson Skull at the harbor will not turn hostile and [[Cho Wei the Skull Axe]] does not spawn. *** The bridge after the "s"-like mountain will not have Crimson Skull popup. == Trivia == * During the dialogue between Farmer Xeng Jo and the Crimson Skull Hunter, Xeng Jo is said to be from Tsumei Village. However, the conversation takes place in [[Kaitan Village]]. {{bug|Along the western coast you can see a brown colored area where the map is intended to end. It seems similar to the [[end of the world]] in [[The Great Northern Wall]] mission.}} {{Explorable areas in Shing Jea Island}} [[de:Panjiang-Halbinsel]]
